'''2007 Maryland State Championship Chris Westergard DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
